mapper.insert: INSERT INTO handling_events (id, booking_id, event_type, location_code, completion_time, memo, receive_confirmation_code, registered_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.bookingId}, #{row.eventType}, #{row.locationCode}, #{row.completionTime}, #{row.memo}, #{row.receiveConfirmationCode}, #{row.registeredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, booking_id, event_type, location_code, completion_time, memo, receive_confirmation_code, registered_at FROM handling_events WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} ORDER BY completion_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, booking_id, event_type, location_code, completion_time, memo, receive_confirmation_code, registered_at FROM handling_events ORDER BY completion_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
